title: MoonEyes/google-ecommerce-mcp
summary: Inspect product-level issues, view configured data sources, and run Merchant reports.
method: Runtime FastMCP registry inspection; independently re-extracted, with no handlers called.

tools.name: server_status
tools.description:
Which Google services are configured for this server, and whether the stored OAuth token works.
Call it first when another tool answers not_configured or not_authenticated. Returns one boolean per
service, the token storage (os-keyring or file), "token": "ok" or the error, and the package version.
tools.summary: Which Google services are configured for this server, and whether the stored OAuth token works.

tools.name: merchant_data_sources
tools.description: Merchant Center data sources (feeds): labels, countries, languages, fetch URLs.
tools.summary: Merchant Center data sources (feeds): labels, countries, languages, fetch URLs.
notes: Returns one API page; this tool does not expose a continuation parameter.

tools.name: merchant_product_issues
tools.description:
Merchant Center products with their item-level issues (disapprovals, demotions, warnings) per destination,
with the attribute to fix. Scans every page of products up to max_pages. Returns {"products": [{offer_id,
feed_label, title, link, issues: [{code, severity, description, attribute, destination}]}], "scanned": n,
"truncated": bool}.

only_with_issues.description: True: only products with at least one issue; False: every product
only_with_issues.title: Only With Issues

max_pages.description: Pages of 250 products to scan at most
max_pages.title: Max Pages

tools.summary: Merchant Center products with their item-level issues (disapprovals, demotions, warnings) per destination,
notes: Scanning stops at max_pages or limit. Check the returned truncated field and any partial-result error before treating the result as complete.

tools.name: merchant_report_query
tools.description:
Run a Merchant Center report (Merchant API reports:search) with an MCQL query, for example product status
or free-listing performance. Returns Google's raw result rows.

query.default: SELECT id, offer_id, title, aggregated_reporting_context_status FROM product_view LIMIT 50
query.description: Merchant Center Query Language (MCQL) statement. Tables include product_view (must select id) and product_performance_view (clicks, impressions by date or offer)
query.title: Query

tools.summary: Run a Merchant Center report (Merchant API reports:search) with an MCQL query, for example product status
notes: Returns one reports:search response; this tool does not follow continuation tokens.
